outcome: Incidence of major degree placenta previa/placenta accreta spectrum
Risk factors for major degree placenta previa/placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: 299 patients diagnosed with major degree placenta previa/placenta accreta spectrum admitted to Abha Maternity and Children's Hospital, Abha, Saudi Arabia between January 2012 and December 2021
finding: Major degree placenta previa/placenta accreta spectrum was associated with high maternal morbidity but rare mortality, with advanced maternal age, high parity, and previous cesarean deliveries identified as main risk factors.
